<div class="hero"><h1>SPX Beaters <span class="grad">— The Weekly League</span></h1>
<p>Weekly relative-performance research across the engine's reported stock, ETF and asset-class universe. Historical returns and descriptive screen ranks remain available. Scores are <b>not calibrated probabilities</b>; return forecasts, AI verdicts and position sizing are <b>unqualified</b>. Inspect input coverage and observation dates before using any reported figure.</p></div>

<script>
const PROXY="https://justhodl-data-proxy.raafouis.workers.dev";
const fmt=(v,dp=1)=>typeof v!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(v)?"—":v.toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:dp,minimumFractionDigits:0});
const card=(k,v,s,cls)=>`<div class="card"><div class="k">${esc(k)}</div><div class="v ${['pos','neg','amb'].includes(cls)?cls:''}">${esc(v)}</div><div class="s">${esc(s)}</div></div>`;
function mcapS(m){if(m==null)return"";return m>=1e12?fmt(m/1e12,1)+"T":m>=1e9?fmt(m/1e9,1)+"B":fmt(m/1e6,0)+"M"}
function aiLine(r){
 return '<div class="banner"><strong>WAIT · forecast unqualified</strong><div>Return odds, forecast horizon and future downside are unavailable. Cached AI text and screen scores do not establish a calibrated forecast or position size.</div></div>';
}
function esc(value){return String(value==null?'':value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
function rowHtml(r){
 const b=r.score>=70?"b-hi":"b-md";
 const chips=[r.dd_52w_pct!=null?`<b style="color:var(--red)">${fmt(r.dd_52w_pct,0)}% off 52w high</b>`:null,
  r.ret_8w_pct!=null?`8w base ${r.ret_8w_pct>0?"+":""}${fmt(r.ret_8w_pct,0)}%`:null,
  r.fundamentals_intact?"Legacy fundamental classification: unqualified":null,
  r.scope?`scope: ${esc(r.scope)}`:null,
  r.bucket?esc(r.bucket)+" cap":null,
  esc(r.sector||r.class),r.mcap?("$"+mcapS(r.mcap)):null,
  r.ret_6m_pct!=null?`6m ${r.ret_6m_pct>0?"+":""}${fmt(r.ret_6m_pct,0)}%`:null,
  r.rs_6m_pp!=null?`${r.rs_6m_pp>0?"+":""}${fmt(r.rs_6m_pp,0)}pp vs SPY`:null,
  r.ret_12_1_pct!=null?`12-1 ${r.ret_12_1_pct>0?"+":""}${fmt(r.ret_12_1_pct,0)}%`:null,
  r.inst&&r.inst.vol_52w_pct!=null?`vol ${fmt(r.inst.vol_52w_pct,0)}%`:null,
  r.inst&&r.inst.sharpe_mom!=null?`Sharpe-mom ${fmt(r.inst.sharpe_mom,1)}`:null,
  r.inst&&r.inst.rs_consist_26w_pct!=null?`beat SPY ${fmt(r.inst.rs_consist_26w_pct,0)}% of wks`:null,
  "Forward return odds unqualified",
  `${fmt(r.n_legs,0)} reported input legs`].filter(Boolean).map(c=>`<span class="chip">${c}</span>`).join("");
 return `<div class="row"><div class="top"><span class="tk">${esc(r.t)}</span><span class="nm">${esc(r.name||"")}</span><span class="badge ${b}">${fmt(r.score,1)}</span></div>
 <div class="chips">${chips}</div>
 <ul class="why">${(Array.isArray(r.why)?r.why:[]).map(w=>`<li>${esc(w)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>${aiLine(r)}</div>`}
function fill(id,rows,cnt,min){
 const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
 if(!Array.isArray(rows)||!rows.length){el.innerHTML=`<div class="banner">No candidates cleared the ${fmt(min,0)} screen threshold this week; this does not imply a benchmark allocation.</div>`;return}
 el.innerHTML=rows.map(rowHtml).join("")+(cnt>rows.length?`<div class="s" style="color:var(--fg-3);font-size:12px">${cnt-rows.length} more screened names below the top ${rows.length}.</div>`:"")}
async function load(){let D=null;try{D=await (await fetch(`${PROXY}/data/spx-beaters.json?t=${Date.now()}`)).json()}catch(e){}
 if(!D||!D.ok){document.getElementById("regime").innerHTML=`<div class="err">data/spx-beaters.json unavailable — first weekly run may still be pending.</div>`;return}
 const rg=D.regime||{},led=D.ledger||{};
 document.getElementById("regime").innerHTML=[
  card("Position sizing","Unqualified","No allocation from this screen","amb"),
  card("Rotation regime",rg.rotation_regime||"—",""),
  card("SPX ERP (ttm)",rg.spx_erp_ttm_pct==null?"—":fmt(rg.spx_erp_ttm_pct,2)+"%","earnings yield − 10Y",rg.spx_erp_ttm_pct>=0?"pos":"neg"),
  card("Rule of 20",rg.spx_rule_of_20==null?"—":fmt(rg.spx_rule_of_20,1),"",rg.spx_rule_of_20<=20?"pos":"neg"),
  card("SPY 6m",rg.spy_ret_6m_pct==null?"—":(rg.spy_ret_6m_pct>0?"+":"")+fmt(rg.spy_ret_6m_pct,1)+"%","the bar to beat"),
  card("SPY 12-1",rg.spy_ret_12_1_pct==null?"—":(rg.spy_ret_12_1_pct>0?"+":"")+fmt(rg.spy_ret_12_1_pct,1)+"%",""),
  card("Ledger",`${led.weeks||0}/${led.target||53}w`,led.complete?"complete":"accreting weekly"),
  card("Scanned",fmt((D.scanned||{}).stocks,0),`stocks + ${fmt((D.scanned||{}).etfs,0)} ETFs`)].join("");
 const ms=D.mom_status||{};
 document.getElementById("banner").innerHTML=ms.note?`<div class="banner">${esc(ms.note)}. A longer observation window does not establish predictive accuracy.</div>`:"";
 document.getElementById("asof").textContent=`as of ${(D.as_of||"").slice(0,16).replace("T"," ")} UTC · weekly closes ${led.first||"—"} → ${led.last||"—"} · ${rg.note||""}`;
 for(const b of ["large","mid","small","micro","comeback","etf_equity","etf_bond","etf_commodity","etf_crypto_alt"])
  fill("b_"+b,(D.buckets||{})[b],(D.counts||{})[b]||0,D.min_score);
 const br=D.base_rates;
 if(br){const q=br.momentum_quintiles||[];
  document.getElementById("brates").innerHTML=`<div class="banner">Formation: 6-month return 26 weeks ago, quintiled across the full ledger. Outcome: excess return vs SPY over the following 26 weeks (${esc(br.window)}). ${esc(br.caveat)}</div>
  <table><tr><th>Momentum quintile</th><th>Formation 6m range</th><th>n</th><th>Beat SPY next 26w</th><th>Median excess</th></tr>
  ${q.map(x=>`<tr><td class="metric">Q${fmt(x.q,0)}${x.q===5?" (strongest)":x.q===1?" (weakest)":""}</td><td>${fmt(x.form_6m_min_pct,0)}% → ${fmt(x.form_6m_max_pct,0)}%</td><td class="band">${fmt(x.n,0)}</td><td><b>${fmt(x.beat_spy_26w_pct,1)}%</b></td><td>${x.median_excess_pp>0?"+":""}${fmt(x.median_excess_pp,1)}pp</td></tr>`).join("")}
  ${br.comeback_cohort?`<tr><td class="metric">Comeback cohort (dd≤−30%, based)</td><td>—</td><td class="band">${fmt(br.comeback_cohort.n,0)}</td><td><b>${fmt(br.comeback_cohort.beat_spy_26w_pct,1)}%</b></td><td>${br.comeback_cohort.median_excess_pp>0?"+":""}${fmt(br.comeback_cohort.median_excess_pp,1)}pp</td></tr>`:""}</table>
  <div class="s" style="color:var(--fg-3);font-size:12px;margin-top:6px">These reported cohort summaries have not passed point-in-time membership, survivorship, overlapping-window and after-cost validation. They are not company-specific forward probabilities or downside forecasts.</div>`}
 const w=D.weights||{};
 document.getElementById("foot").innerHTML=`<b>Reported method.</b> ${esc(D.method||"")} Stock weights ${esc(JSON.stringify(w.stock))} · ETF weights ${esc(JSON.stringify(w.etf))}. Minimum screen score ${fmt(D.min_score,0)}; comeback threshold ${fmt(D.comeback_min,0)}. Correlated input legs do not count as independent confirmation. Reported descriptions and ranks require separate source, timing and out-of-sample validation. Engine ${esc(D.engine_v)}. An empty bucket provides no buy, sell or allocation instruction.`;
}
load();
</script><script src="/sidebar.js" defer></script>
